title: const left of * vs right of *
tryThis: Uncomment `*p = 5;` and read the error: which variable does the compiler say is read-only?
Uncomment `q = &y;`. Compare the error with the previous one.
Replace `const int* p` with `int const* p`: nothing changes, only the side of `*` matters.
Uncomment `int* sneaky = p;`: removing const is refused even though `y` itself isn't const.
